items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Well, yeah, he was younger than Brock. I mean, he'd taken Brock's place.

ctx.x: Stanley's a bricklayer, but he had another brother by the name of Sidney Stahl, but he died. He was a blast truck. But Stanley's still living, I think, he's still out here.

Yeah, well, Lorenzo was a bricklayer, but he had another brother by the name of Sidney Stahls, but he died. He was a blast truck. But Stanley's still living, I think, he's still out here. Yeah, well, Lorenzo was one of the best guitar players we had uptown.

Was he really a good guitar player? Yeah, he was a good guitar player. Well, you used to sing some of these songs at Fest and I was a little while. Yeah, yeah, yeah, a little while. You think he was mostly an entertainer or he was really a good musician? Yes, he was. A good guitar player.
